chunks: 'And it is indeed a Reminder for you and your people, and you shall soon be questioned'

So the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) is the Dhikr (Reminder), and the People of his Household (peace be upon them) are al-Mas'ulun (the ones to be questioned), and they are the Ahl al-Dhikr (People of the Reminder).

key_terms.أَهْلُ الذِّكْر: Ahl al-Dhikr — People of the Reminder; an Imam title derived from Quran 16:43 and 21:7 ('Ask the people of the Reminder if you do not know')
key_terms.الذِّكْر: Dhikr — used here as a title for the Prophet Muhammad: the embodiment of divine remembrance and reminder
key_terms.الْمَسْئُولُونَ: Al-Mas'ulun — the ones to be questioned/asked; identifies the Ahl al-Bayt as the required authorities for religious questions

ai.seo_question: Who are the Ahl al-Dhikr (People of the Reminder) according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) interprets Quran 43:44 — 'It is indeed a Reminder for you and your people, and you shall soon be questioned' — explaining that the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) is himself the Dhikr (Reminder/Remembrance), and the Ahl al-Bayt are the Ahl al-Dhikr, the ones whom God commanded people to ask (as in Quran 16:43 and 21:7). This hadith is one of the foundational narrations in the chapter establishing the Imams as the authoritative sources of religious guidance, whom Muslims are obligated to consult.
word_analysis: are the ones to be questioned

Mighty and Majestic [43:44] And it is a Reminder for you and your people, and you shall soon be questioned
: ‘So, Rasool-Allahsaww is the Zikr (Reminder), and the Peopleasws of hissaww Household are the asked ones, and theyasws are the Ahl Al-Zikr (The People of the Reminder)’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from ‘Asim ibn Hamid from abu Basir from Imam abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following about the words of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High.
“It is a Dhikr for you and for your people and you all will be asked questions.’ [43:44]
The Messenger of Allah is the Dhikr (reminder of Allah) and members of his family (a.s.) are the ones who will be asked questions and they are the people of Dhikr.”
